brief: public Reader parse(InputStream stream) throws IOException{}
method_comment:
* Parses the given document and returns the extracted text content. *

* The returned reader will be responsible for closing the given stream. * The stream and any associated resources will be closed at or before * the time when the {@link Reader#close()} method is called. * * @param stream the document to be parsed * @return extracted text content * @throws IOException if the document can not be read or parsed
